paddy.task: Best season to start. Treat seeds with salt water. Prepare raised nursery beds.
Critical growth phase. Maintain 2-5cm water level. Apply first Urea top dressing.
Apply Potash. Monitor for Stem Borer and Blast. Keep water level low but consistent.
Drain field 10 days before cutting. Harvest when 80% grains are golden.
Deep summer ploughing to kill soil pests. Test soil health.

wheat.task: Best time: Nov 1-15. Sow at 5cm depth. Pre-sowing irrigation (Palewa) is essential.
Critical Irrigation (CRI) at 21 days is mandatory. Check for yellow rust.
Harvest when grain hardens and moisture is <20%. Thresh and store in dry bins.
Land preparation for next Kharif crop.

millet.task: Best for Ragi/Bajra. Sow with onset of monsoon. spacing 25x10 cm.
Weeding and thinning (2 weeks after sowing) is crucial for yield.
Harvest when earheads turn brown/yellow. Dry well before threshing.
Apply organic manure. Plan for crop rotation with pulses.
